title: Locked A=45deg/B=135deg/4-cycles convention in context/figures/grating.py; not yet integrated into any figure

claims.text: IDENTITY_ORIENTATION_DEG = {A: 45, B: 135}, IDENTITY_N_CYCLES = 4, added to grating.py as named constants plus an identity_grating() helper. R-family deliberately left without a fixed orientation (raises ValueError if requested) since R is the random-control family by construction -- a fixed third orientation would misrepresent it as a third identity. build_identity_demo() renders AAAB/AXAB/BBBA/BXBA as 4-icon sequences (using omission_marker() for the omitted slot) to preview the convention in context rather than in isolation.
claims.receipt: python grating.py: 'wrote grating_identity_demo.svg 414x316'; reuses circular_grating()/omission_marker(), whose correctness was already confirmed in a real browser render for the 0/45/90/135deg orientation sweep and 2/4/6/8-cycle frequency sweep in the prior demo

issues: Not yet integrated into any real figure. fig01 Panel C's block-type grids (AAAB/BBBA/RRRR) are a single baked raster image per the 2026-07-30 redesign investigation -- replacing individual per-cell icons there means reconstructing the whole grid as vector, not a drop-in swap. Where (if anywhere) to actually apply this convention has not been confirmed with the user.
